rationale: M49 W22 (rotation-found on vue-core packages/reactivity/src/effect.ts): a CLASS implementing an in-file INTERFACE emitted no override for the members it supplies, so ReactiveEffect.notify -> Subscriber.notify was permanently MISSING while the oracle derived it generically (declParents takes extends AND implements edges whose target resolves in-file) and java already carries the same contract (clojure TransformerIterator: Empty.add -> Buffer.add, probe-verified). The gain is pinned beside every ABSTENTION the name-only pairing would get wrong: a class FIELD implementing an interface property must NOT pair (the oracle keeps public_field_definition out of its member set so truth cannot outrun the analyzer), an overloaded interface name abstains (two notify declarations cannot be paired name-only), an EXTERNAL/qualified base resolves to no in-file declaration, and a member the interface never declares pairs with nothing. Also pins the M59.A7 implements-line repair (6 unstamped edges measured across the four TS corpora + 1 delegated from svelte; the 40-file oracle sample drew none, which is why the milestone instrument read 0 noLine): every implements edge carries the interface NAME's line, parallel to extendsLines.
